name: rehabalpha-pcc-sync
description: PointClickCare to RehabAlpha synchronization: architecture and reference implementation

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @rehabalpha/core && npm run build --workspace @rehabalpha/pcc-client && npm run build --workspace @rehabalpha/sync
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @rehabalpha/functions && npm run build --workspace @rehabalpha/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.typecheck.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: vitest run --project core --project pcc-client --project sync-unit --project web-unit
scripts.test:emulator: node scripts/with-emulators.mjs vitest run --project sync-emulator --project functions --project rules
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:emulator
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:all
